Regarding database naming conventions, [p1] set the PostgreSQL name to `db.allunite.local`. [me] suggested `pg.allunite.com`, but [p1] insisted on using `.local` as it is an internal domain.
decisions: The removal of domains ending in .i.allunite.com and associated legacy infrastructure is underway.
Database connection names should use the internal domain suffix, specifically `db.allunite.local` for PostgreSQL.
